reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "RSA certificates with keys of length 3072 or 4096 will now use SHA-384 or SHA-512 respectively as hash algorithms", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: RSA certificates with 3072/4096-bit keys are signed with SHA-384/SHA-512 as they rotate; widely supported, but errors may appear with clients that don't support these hashes.

proposed.statement: RSA certificates with 3072- or 4096-bit keys are now signed with SHA-384 or SHA-512 respectively, which may cause errors with peers that don't support these hashes as keys rotate.
